entries.expectedBasis: Scored as launched on the API (6 Oct 2025): the best size at launch was sora-2-pro at 1792x1024 (about 1024p; 1080p was added on 12 Mar 2026 per the official changelog), so 3.5 between the 720p and 1080p anchors. Duration 12 s is the launch maximum as reported by Replicate's readme ('4 to 12 seconds') and AIBase ('12 or 16 seconds'); OpenAI's own launch-day page was not readable, so 3.5 is cautious. Native synced audio. Input is text plus one image reference, with a remix call, so 2.5. Speed and realism null: no published render time, and only one genuine hands-on review of the API-era model exists (DIY AI, July 2026, praise) against Artificial Analysis ranking Sora 2 Pro below rivals as relayed by Wikipedia and a MindStudio comparison that is not a test, so there is no two-review consensus.
